data.revised_prompt: Create a high-quality 1:1 square icon asset for a school teacher student-avatar library. One fictional Chinese girl only, age 8–14, healthy, natural, friendly, clearly identifiable as a student. 3D cute educational app art style, refined modeling, soft materials, bright brown eyes, studio soft lighting. Composition: centered, front-facing or slight three-quarter view, tightly focused on the head; full hair silhouette visible; face and hair occupy 75%–85% of the square; only a very small amount of neck and shoulders visible at the bottom; definitely not a half-body portrait. Expression: happy big smile with a natural mouth shape. Hair: neat straight bangs, left and right twin ponytails, two lake-blue hair ties. Clothing: only a tiny hint of white school-style collared neckline at the bottom, no school emblem, no text. Background: solid soft sky-blue filling the entire square edge-to-edge and corner-to-corner, no white border, no transparency, no circular avatar frame, no ring, no scene. Make the avatar highly readable at 48px and in rectangular PC lists: clear hairstyle silhouette, clear facial outline, high contrast, simple centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal detail, no clutter. Avoid: half-body, upper body, full body, hands, gestures, props, teachers, adults, headset, headphones, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, complex clothing, head crop, hair crop, chin crop, face too small, off-center subject, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent background, circular background, avatar frame, ring, strong halo, complex scene, text, letters, numbers, school emblem, logo, watermark, multiple characters, real photo, flat 2D illustration, cel shading, baby proportions, dark tones, neon, low resolution, distorted facial features.
